cases.name: Keep meaning without movement
cases.prompt: Update modal.css using this skill. Preserve the normal opening animation. Add reduced-motion treatment that retains a visible entrance without movement. Disable the purely decorative idle loop under reduced motion. Work only in this task folder. Do not use the network or install packages.

checks.name: Native evidence shows the target skill loaded
Reduced-motion media query, fade and stopped decorative motion

args: import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs'; const s=readFileSync('modal.css','utf8'); assert.match(s,/@media\s*\(prefers-reduced-motion:\s*reduce\)/); assert.match(s,/@keyframes\s+enter/); assert.match(s,/translateY/); const reduced=s.slice(s.indexOf('@media')); assert.match(reduced,/\.decoration\s*\{[^}]*animation(?:-name)?\s*:\s*none/); const modal=reduced.match(/\.modal\s*\{([^}]+)\}/)?.[1]; assert.ok(modal); const name=modal.match(/animation(?:-name)?\s*:\s*([\w-]+)/)?.[1]; assert.ok(name && name!=='none' && name!=='enter'); const start=s.indexOf('@keyframes '+name); assert.ok(start>=0); const frames=s.slice(start,s.indexOf('}',s.indexOf('}',start)+1)+1); assert.match(frames,/opacity/); assert.doesNotMatch(frames,/transform|translate|scale/);

cases.name: Respect live reduced-motion preference
cases.prompt: Update scroll.mjs using this skill. Keep scrollToSection(element). Respect the current motion preference on each call without removing scrolling or changing the destination. Work only in this task folder. Do not use the network or install packages.

checks.name: Native evidence shows the target skill loaded
Smooth only without reduced motion; preference can change

args: import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import {scrollToSection} from './scroll.mjs'; let reduce=true; const queries=[]; globalThis.matchMedia=q=>{queries.push(q);return {matches:q.includes('no-preference')?!reduce:reduce}}; globalThis.window=globalThis; const seen=[]; const element={scrollIntoView:options=>seen.push(options)}; scrollToSection(element); assert.ok(['auto','instant'].includes(seen[0].behavior)); assert.equal(seen[0].block,'start'); reduce=false; scrollToSection(element); assert.equal(seen[1].behavior,'smooth'); reduce=true; scrollToSection(element); assert.ok(['auto','instant'].includes(seen[2].behavior)); assert.ok(queries.every(q=>q.includes('prefers-reduced-motion')));
